decisions.action: POWO/WCVP accepts the existing canonical name; Hitchcock published combination in 1933. No species rename or new card.
Retain the 1857 basionym as a searchable historical alias, not a second learner taxon.
Map historic Sporobolus combination to the existing Muhlenbergia species, preserving original authorship.
Historical Vilfa name resolves to M. utilis in POWO; not an accepted extra species.
POWO lists this name pro syn; record source spelling without treating it as a separately validly published accepted species.
Kew accepts M. repens independently; Hitchcock's 1933 protologue explicitly says M. utilis had formerly been treated as its synonym but was distinguished as a more delicate species.
ITIS lists this variant as a synonym; do not create a second genus or species. POWO's displayed four-synonym set does not enumerate this spelling.

decisions.source_name: Historical Muhlenbergia utilis treated as Muhlenbergia repens
decisions.action: Reject automatic merger: both are accepted species today, despite older synonym treatment. Voucher evidence required for historical determinations.

decisions.source_name: Vilfa utilis / Sporobolus utilis / Vilfa sacatilla / Sporobolus sacatilla
decisions.action: Reject new species cards for four POWO-listed synonyms; retain original name strings and source provenance.
Do not infer accepted species rank or valid publication from a pro syn listing; original 1886 nomenclatural details were not independently resolved here.

decisions.source_name: Individual Muhlenbergia utilis gallery photographs or vouchers
decisions.action: Taxonomy name audit does not authenticate photographed plants, measured rhizomes, or individual herbarium vouchers; preserve all existing visual ID holds.

decisions.source_name: Individual hybrid, introgression, or cultivated ancestry of Muhlenbergia utilis
decisions.action: No named hybrid parentage or individual hybrid origin is established by these sources; do not infer ancestry or override scientific holds.

decisions.source_name: Sporobolus sacatilla E.Fourn. versus Griseb. ex E.Fourn.
decisions.action: POWO uses E.Fourn. and marks pro syn; ITIS uses Griseb. ex E.Fourn. The 1886 original publication was not directly checked, so retain source-qualified spellings and do not assert which author form is correct.

decisions.source_name: Unvouchered historical records assigned to M. repens or M. utilis
decisions.action: Historical records without original voucher, date, author-qualified taxon treatment or reproductive anatomy cannot be reassigned from one accepted species to the other by names alone.

source_notes.POWO_WCVP: 2026-10-26 accepted M. utilis (Torr.) Hitchc. 1933, four listed synonyms, separately accepted M. repens; no infraspecific rank created.
source_notes.ITIS: ITIS TSN 41892 recognizes M. utilis, records Muehlenbergia spelling and Sporobolus sacatilla with expanded historical author. Divergent authorship retained UNRESOLVED.
source_notes.original_1933: Hitchcock, Grasses from Texas, Journal of the Washington Academy of Sciences 23:453 (15 Oct 1933), explicitly states M. utilis had been referred to M. repens as synonym but differs.
source_notes.primary_2023: Peterson, Herrera Arrieta, Lobo Cabezas & Romaschenko (2023), PhytoKeys 230:1-106 DOI 10.3897/phytokeys.230.103882; treatment includes M. utilis and its Vilfa/Sporobolus type combinations.
source_notes.historical_protologue_limit: Original Fournier 1886 page not independently examined; retain authorship UNRESOLVED rather than invent a correction.
